summary_ja: 当座貸越の供与対象者の信用度を評価する厳格な基準を設けることを定める。
summary_en: Requires strict criteria for assessing the creditworthiness of overdraft recipients.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall establish strict criteria for assessing the creditworthiness of persons to whom overdrafts are extended.
